dct_description_sm: This dataset contains monthly biological sample from watercourses located across the Lower Thames Valley Conservation Authority (LTVCA) jurisdiction by LTVCA staff. The Biological Water Quality Dataset for LTVCA includes water quality results from monthly watershed-scale monitoring beginning in 2008. Analyzed parameters include total coliforms, Escherichia coli (E. coli), background coliforms, and heterotrophic plate count (HPC), which are used to assess microbial water quality conditions.
dct_title_s: Lower Thames Valley Conservation Authority (LTVCA) - Biological Water Quality Data
